feat(#383): agent-based OCC emotions — Pride, Shame, Admiration, Reproach

ActionAppraisal SPI parallel to GoalAppraisal. HeuristicActionAppraisal
with asymmetric personality-modulated thresholds (strict agents: easy
Shame, hard Pride). Inline compound detection: Gratification, Remorse,
Gratitude, Anger. ActionAppraisalObserver CDI real-time on Outcome events
with dual-path self/other appraisal via TARGET_AGENT. AppraisalWeights
extended with selfStandardsStrictness and otherStandardsStrictness
derived from DispositionAxes. EmotionSource.ATTRIBUTED for other-agent
judgment. 27 new tests.

Closes #383
